content.query: datatable(Section:string, Represents:string, WhyItMatters:string)[ 'Service Health Summary','30-minute health view for the web app, ACA platform, Key Vault, and Redis','Start here to answer: are we healthy right now?', 'Customer Traffic Summary','24-hour traffic and latency excluding platform probes','Shows customer-facing volume instead of /api/health noise', 'Request Outcome Mix','Distribution of success, redirects, client errors, and server errors','Makes the quality of traffic obvious at a glance', 'Top Endpoints','Most frequently hit routes with latency context','Shows which journeys are most active', 'Failures, Exceptions, And Platform Events','The most recent things a support engineer should inspect','Use these tables to drill into what broke and where' ]
content.title: What This Dashboard Shows

content.query: let WebRequests = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sum(ItemCount)); let WebFailedRequests = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sumif(ItemCount, Success == false or tostring(ResultCode) startswith '5')); let WebExceptions = toscalar(AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' | summarize sum(ItemCount)); let KeyVaultDependencyFailures = toscalar(AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and (Target has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__' or Data has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__') | summarize sumif(ItemCount, Success == false)); let KeyVaultDependencyCalls = toscalar(AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and (Target has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__' or Data has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__') | summarize sum(ItemCount)); let RedisConnectedClients = toscalar(AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' != '' and _ResourceId =~ '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' | extend MetricNameLower = tolower(MetricName) | where MetricNameLower == 'connectedclients' | summarize max(Maximum)); let RedisCacheLatency = toscalar(AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | where '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' != '' and _ResourceId =~ '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' | extend MetricNameLower = tolower(MetricName) | where MetricNameLower == 'cachelatency' | summarize avg(Average)); let ContainerPlatformErrors = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppSystemLogs, ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(30m) | extend ContainerApp=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))) | where ContainerApp =~ '__CONTAINER_APP_NAME__' | extend LogLevel=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('LogLevel', ''), column_ifexists('LogLevel_s', ''))), Reason=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Reason', ''), column_ifexists('Reason_s', ''))) | where LogLevel =~ 'Error' or Reason has_any ('Error', 'Failed', 'BackOff', 'Crash') | count); union (print Service='Web App', Status=iff(coalesce(WebFailedRequests, 0) == 0 and coalesce(WebExceptions, 0) == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention'), Signal=strcat(coalesce(WebFailedRequests, 0), ' failed requests, ', coalesce(WebExceptions, 0), ' exceptions (30m)'), Detail=strcat('Customer requests: ', coalesce(WebRequests, 0))), (print Service='ACA Platform', Status=iff(coalesce(ContainerPlatformErrors, 0) == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention'), Signal=strcat(coalesce(ContainerPlatformErrors, 0), ' platform errors (30m)'), Detail='Source: Container Apps system logs'), (print Service='Key Vault', Status=iff(coalesce(KeyVaultDependencyFailures, 0) == 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention'), Signal=strcat(coalesce(KeyVaultDependencyFailures, 0), ' dependency failures (30m)'), Detail=strcat('Dependency calls: ', coalesce(KeyVaultDependencyCalls, 0))), (print Service='Redis', Status=iff('__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' == '', 'Not configured', iff(coalesce(RedisConnectedClients, 0.0) >= 0, 'Healthy', 'Attention')), Signal=iff('__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' == '', 'Not configured', strcat('Connected clients: ', round(coalesce(RedisConnectedClients, 0.0), 0))), Detail=iff('__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' == '', 'No Redis resource for this environment', strcat('__REDIS_NAME__', ': avg cache latency (microseconds): ', round(coalesce(RedisCacheLatency, 0.0), 0))))
content.title: Service Health Summary (30m)

content.query: let Requests = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sum(ItemCount)); let Redirects = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sumif(ItemCount, tostring(ResultCode) startswith '3')); let ClientErrors = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sumif(ItemCount, tostring(ResultCode) startswith '4')); let ServerErrors = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize sumif(ItemCount, Success == false or tostring(ResultCode) startswith '5')); let Exceptions = toscalar(AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' | summarize sum(ItemCount)); let P95DurationMs = toscalar(AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize percentile(DurationMs, 95)); print Requests=coalesce(Requests, 0), Redirects=coalesce(Redirects, 0), ClientErrors=coalesce(ClientErrors, 0), ServerErrors=coalesce(ServerErrors, 0), Exceptions=coalesce(Exceptions, 0), FailureRatePct=iff(coalesce(Requests, 0) == 0, 0.0, round((todouble(ServerErrors) / todouble(Requests)) * 100.0, 2)), P95DurationMs=round(coalesce(P95DurationMs, 0.0), 0)
content.title: Customer Traffic Summary (24h)

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | extend Outcome=case(tostring(ResultCode) startswith '5' or Success == false, 'Server errors', tostring(ResultCode) startswith '4', 'Client errors', tostring(ResultCode) startswith '3', 'Redirects', 'Successful requests') | summarize Requests=sum(ItemCount) by Outcome | order by Requests desc
content.title: Request Outcome Mix (24h)

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize Requests=sum(ItemCount), FailedRequests=sumif(ItemCount, Success == false or tostring(ResultCode) startswith '5') by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests And Failed Requests (24h)

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | summarize Requests=sum(ItemCount), P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by OperationName=Name | top 10 by Requests desc
content.title: Top Endpoints By Request Volume

content.query: AppTraces | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' | extend Audit=tostring(Properties.audit), Event=tostring(Properties.event), Outcome=tostring(Properties.outcome) | where Audit =~ 'true' or Event startswith 'auth.' or Event == 'security.inspector' | summarize Events=sum(ItemCount) by Category=iff(isempty(Outcome), Event, strcat(Event, ' / ', Outcome)) | top 10 by Events desc
content.title: Auth And Security Event Mix

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and (Target has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__' or Data has '__KEY_VAULT_URI__') | summarize Calls=sum(ItemCount), FailedCalls=sumif(ItemCount, Success == false), P95DurationMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Target | order by FailedCalls desc, Calls desc
content.title: Key Vault Dependency Health

content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' != '' and _ResourceId =~ '__REDIS_RESOURCE_ID__' | extend MetricNameLower = tolower(MetricName) | where MetricNameLower in ('connectedclients', 'cachelatency', 'cachehits', 'cachemisses') | summarize Average=avg(Average), Maximum=max(Maximum), Total=sum(Total) by MetricName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Redis Metrics Trend

content.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where (AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__') and tostring(Name) !has '/api/health' and tostring(Url) !has '/api/health' | where Success == false or tostring(ResultCode) startswith '5' | project TimeGenerated, OperationName=Name, Url, ResultCode, DurationMs, SessionId, OperationId | top 25 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent Failed Requests

content.query: AppExceptions | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where AppRoleName =~ '__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' or AppRoleName endswith '.__TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME__' | project TimeGenerated, ExceptionType, ProblemId, Message, InnermostMessage, OperationName | top 25 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent Exceptions

content.query: union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs, ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend ContainerApp=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))) | where ContainerApp =~ '__CONTAINER_APP_NAME__' | extend Revision=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('RevisionName', ''), column_ifexists('RevisionName_s', ''))), Stream=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Stream', ''), column_ifexists('Stream_s', ''))), LogText=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Log', ''), column_ifexists('Log_s', ''))) | extend AppLogLevel=tolower(tostring(extractjson('$.level', LogText, typeof(string)))), AppMessage=tostring(extractjson('$.message', LogText, typeof(string))) | where Stream =~ 'stderr' or AppLogLevel in ('warn', 'warning', 'error', 'fatal') | project TimeGenerated, Revision, Stream, AppLogLevel, Message=iff(isempty(AppMessage), LogText, AppMessage), RawLog=LogText | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Container Console Warnings And Errors

content.query: union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppSystemLogs, ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend ContainerApp=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))), Revision=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('RevisionName', ''), column_ifexists('RevisionName_s', ''))), Replica=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ReplicaName', ''), column_ifexists('ReplicaName_s', ''))) | where ContainerApp =~ '__CONTAINER_APP_NAME__' | summarize Events=count() by Revision, Replica | order by Events desc
content.title: Replica And Revision Activity

content.query: union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppSystemLogs, ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend ContainerApp=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''))) | where ContainerApp =~ '__CONTAINER_APP_NAME__' | project TimeGenerated, Revision=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('RevisionName', ''), column_ifexists('RevisionName_s', ''))), Replica=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('ReplicaName', ''), column_ifexists('ReplicaName_s', ''))), LogLevel=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('LogLevel', ''), column_ifexists('LogLevel_s', ''))), Reason=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Reason', ''), column_ifexists('Reason_s', ''))), Message=tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('Log', ''), column_ifexists('Log_s', ''))) | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent Container Platform Events
